name: Lizard Photonics
description: Lizard Photonics is a DTU Electro spinout commercializing a nanoelectromechanical (NEMS) photonics platform for custom photonic-circuit design, optical testing, packaging, and nanofabrication. Founded by Ali Nawaz Babar (CEO), Michael Juhl (CTO), and Soren Stobbe (CSO; head of the Quantum & Nanophotonics section at DTU Electro), the company is a partner in the DKK 40M Innovation Fund Denmark EQUAL project for erbium-based silicon quantum light sources (May 2025 - 2030).

news.title: Research project to crack the code of quantum light sources and quantum networks
news.excerpt: A new Danish-German research collaboration is developing new quantum light sources, which could revolutionize cryptography and networks between quantum computers. The Innovation Fund has invested DKK 40 million in the project.
